gate: ROOT_GO_LOCAL_LATENCY plus current three hashes and passed unchanged full-suite/UI seal, scheduled only after primary.
construction: Observer defines100 heterogeneous native demands and formal observations once before controller work, like existing storage load control. Background source publications are generated by existing postsPerHour schedule. No new stocks or trips; no model intake execution.
measurement: Monotonic host clocks within a single process/browser. Never subtract source simulatedAt from wall clocks. Four stores ingest sequentially at each source pump; actual received feed pages instrument first-seen source version→durable transaction readback.
UI: Authenticated real browser navigation→render/next paint. API RTT and DOM time remain separate. Local field-report writes do not approve or dispatch aid. Readback verifies exact ID/version before visible-state timing.
limitations: Virtual10k/hour source schedule is not10k/hour real-time semantic throughput or physically paced traffic.
UI measurements are one desktop viewport and one hardware configuration, not mobile/human comprehension.
Durable HTTP ACK/readback is process-local transaction durability, not crash/restart durability or ENOSPC; separate tests cover those.
Ingestion starts when a feed page is accessible to this connector. Source publication→first polling delay is recorded separately in source-clock units; unread pages remain missing/censored.
No K11/K13 semantic precision, model latency or lives-saved effect is implied. Strict targets are assessed only for the actually sampled operations and scope.
